results.content: Through in-house R&D, we have developed natural materials used in food and cosmetics, including concentrated extracts made from powdered ingredients. We have also conducted R&D on licorice-based technologies and products in collaboration with government agencies and local institutions such as the Korea Agro-Fisheries&Food Trade Corporation(aT), the Korea Forest Service, and Jeonbuk Technopark. As a result, we are recognized as one of the companies of interest by multiple public institutions, [...] The company has its own manufacturing facility certified with organic processed food and HACCP certifications, as well as a corporate research institute, focusing on product development and production. Additionally, the company operates its own organic brand “Dajeong Heon” and offers various products through online and offline sales channels. [...] Through the development and operation of various honey products, the company seeks to stimulate the local economy, promote income generation linked to honey and eco-friendly organic products, and grow as a leading enterprise in developing tourism resources and products.
